_note: Emotions marked source=owner use the owner's names and descriptions from WHOLEDONUTS.CLOUD/emotional-periodic-table.html (Table928). source=draft entries and all solutions are original drafts for the owner to edit. Reflection aid, not diagnosis or treatment.

elements.name: Calm
elements.definition: Your mind and body feel steady; often after rest, safety, or understanding.
elements.negative: If calm feels like numbness, check in with what you feel.
elements.positive: Protect it with rest, nature, and slow breaths.

elements.name: Curious
elements.definition: You want to explore or learn something new; the beginning of growth.
elements.negative: If it leads to risk, pause and choose safe ways to explore.
elements.positive: Ask questions and try things.

elements.name: Overwhelmed
elements.definition: Too many thoughts or feelings at once; signals a need for pause or support.
elements.negative: List everything, pick one thing, and ask for help.
elements.positive: One step at a time works.

elements.name: Confused
elements.definition: Something doesn’t make sense yet; first step toward clarity.
elements.negative: If it slips, list past things you handled.
elements.positive: Keep learning and stay open to feedback.

elements.name: Hopeful
elements.definition: You can see a good future or positive change coming; spark of momentum.
elements.negative: If it is fading, borrow hope from others' stories.
elements.positive: Pair it with a step.

elements.name: Sad
elements.definition: Something mattered and changed; sign of care, connection, and healing.

elements.name: Anxious
elements.definition: Your mind imagines danger or uncertainty; needs grounding and reassurance.
elements.negative: Breathe in for four, out for six; ground yourself by naming five things you see.
elements.positive: Turn worry into a short plan and ask for support.

elements.name: Excited
elements.definition: Your energy rises toward something good; emotion of action and movement.
elements.negative: If nerves mix in, breathe and prepare.
elements.positive: Use the energy to act.

elements.name: Lonely
elements.definition: You feel separate or unseen; signals a need for connection or being heard.
elements.negative: Reach out, even briefly; join something with shared interests.
elements.positive: Be the friend you wish you had.

elements.name: Embarrassed
elements.definition: You feel exposed or judged; often tied to mistakes or attention.
elements.negative: Remember it fades; breathe and laugh if you can.
elements.positive: Owning it makes you relatable.

elements.name: Angry
elements.definition: You feel something is unfair or wrong; energy that needs safe direction.

elements.name: Frustrated
elements.definition: You feel blocked from what you want; calls for adjustment or patience.
elements.negative: Take a break and try another route.
elements.positive: Persistence plus new ideas solves a lot.

elements.name: Grateful
elements.definition: You notice something good and appreciate it; strengthens relationships.
elements.negative: If it feels forced, start with something tiny.
elements.positive: Write or say three thanks a day.

elements.name: Proud
elements.definition: You feel good about what you did or who you’re becoming.

elements.name: Guilty
elements.definition: You feel you did something wrong; invites repair and learning.
elements.negative: Make it right if you can and learn from it.
elements.positive: Guilt shows your values; let it guide you.

elements.name: Ashamed
elements.definition: You feel something is wrong with you; needs compassion and truth.

elements.name: Jealous
elements.definition: You want what someone else has; can reveal your own desires.
elements.negative: Talk honestly about the fear instead of blaming.
elements.positive: Build trust and your own worth.

elements.name: Envious
elements.definition: You compare yourself and feel less; invites self‑worth and perspective.

elements.name: Bored
elements.definition: Nothing feels engaging; signals a need for challenge or creativity.
elements.negative: Try something new, however small; move your body.
elements.positive: Boredom makes room for creativity; follow an idea.

elements.name: Tired
elements.definition: Your body or mind needs rest; not weakness, just a limit.

elements.name: Stressed
elements.definition: Too much pressure or expectation; needs boundaries and support.
elements.negative: Move, sleep, and pare down.
elements.positive: Use it to prioritize.

elements.name: Relieved
elements.definition: Something hard is over or safer; your system is exhaling.
elements.negative: Use the calm to rest.
elements.positive: Notice what helped.

elements.name: Inspired
elements.definition: You see something that makes you want to create or act.
elements.negative: If it fades, write it down fast.
elements.positive: Start now, even small.

elements.name: Motivated
elements.definition: You feel ready to move toward a goal; energy with direction.

elements.name: Disappointed
elements.definition: Reality didn’t match your hope; invites new expectations.
elements.negative: Let yourself feel it, then ask what is still possible.
elements.positive: New hopes can grow from old ones.

elements.name: Rejected
elements.definition: You feel pushed away or unwanted; needs care and perspective.
elements.negative: It is not a verdict on your worth; lean on supportive people.
elements.positive: Keep trying where you are valued.

elements.name: Included
elements.definition: You feel part of something; belonging strengthens identity.

elements.name: Secure
elements.definition: You feel safe and supported; foundation for growth.

elements.name: Insecure
elements.definition: You doubt your worth or place; needs truth and reassurance.
elements.negative: Notice your strengths and talk back to harsh thoughts.
elements.positive: Surround yourself with people who lift you.

elements.name: Confident
elements.definition: You trust your ability to handle what’s ahead.
elements.negative: Break it into parts and ask one clear question.
elements.positive: Questions lead to understanding; ask them.

elements.name: Nervous
elements.definition: You feel shaky before something important; often near growth.
elements.negative: Slow your breathing and prepare.
elements.positive: Nerves show you care.

elements.name: Peaceful
elements.definition: Your mind and body feel quiet and okay, even if life isn’t perfect.
elements.negative: If it feels fragile, return to your breath.
elements.positive: Protect it with routines you love.

elements.name: Restless
elements.definition: You feel like you need to move or change something.

elements.name: Lost
elements.definition: You don’t know what to do next; invites guidance and small steps.

elements.name: Found
elements.definition: You feel seen, understood, or back on track.

elements.name: Hurt
elements.definition: Something or someone impacted you deeply; needs care and validation.
elements.negative: Name it and say it to someone safe.
elements.positive: Hurt heals with care and time.

elements.name: Supported
elements.definition: You feel backed up by someone or something; you’re not alone.

elements.name: Ignored
elements.definition: You feel unseen or unheard; your voice matters.

elements.name: Validated
elements.definition: Someone understands and accepts your experience as real.

elements.name: Conflicted
elements.definition: Two parts of you want different things; needs sorting and patience.

elements.name: Determined
elements.definition: You feel committed to keep going, even when it’s hard.

elements.name: Hopeless
elements.definition: You can’t see a way forward yet; needs light, support, and time.
elements.negative: Reach out today; call or text 988 (US) if you feel unsafe.
elements.positive: Others have felt this and found a way; you can too.

elements.name: Optimistic
elements.definition: You expect things can improve; lens of possibility.
elements.negative: Balance it with a plan.
elements.positive: Use it to start things.

elements.name: Pessimistic
elements.definition: You expect things to go wrong; often a protection strategy.
elements.negative: Ask what evidence supports it and what else could be true.
elements.positive: Use it to prepare, not to quit.

elements.name: Protective
elements.definition: You want to guard yourself or others from harm.

elements.name: Playful
elements.definition: You feel free to joke, explore, and have fun.

elements.name: Serious
elements.definition: You feel focused and aware of the weight of something.

elements.name: Connected
elements.definition: You feel close to someone or something meaningful.

elements.name: Detached
elements.definition: You feel distant or numb; often a way to cope.

elements.name: Numb
elements.definition: You don’t feel much at all; your system may be protecting you.
elements.negative: Warm water, movement, and talking to someone can help.
elements.positive: Feeling returns gently with care.

elements.name: Vulnerable
elements.definition: You feel open and exposed; also where real connection happens.
elements.negative: Share with safe people only.
elements.positive: It builds real connection.

elements.name: Brave
elements.definition: You act even while feeling fear or uncertainty.

elements.name: Scared
elements.definition: You sense danger; needs safety, truth, and support.

elements.name: Content
elements.definition: You feel okay with what you have right now.
elements.negative: Ask what hurt sits underneath and try curiosity instead.
elements.positive: Replace judgment with a boundary that respects both of you.

elements.name: Unsatisfied
elements.definition: You want more or different; can lead to growth or frustration.

elements.name: Creative
elements.definition: You feel ideas and expression wanting to come out.

elements.name: Blocked
elements.definition: You feel stuck creatively or emotionally; needs space or change.

elements.name: Trusting
elements.definition: You believe someone or something is safe and reliable.
elements.negative: If broken, rebuild slowly.
elements.positive: Be trustworthy first.

elements.name: Distrustful
elements.definition: You doubt safety or honesty; often from past hurt.

elements.name: Regretful
elements.definition: You wish you had chosen differently; invites learning and repair.
elements.negative: Learn, apologize if needed, and move on.
elements.positive: Let it guide your next choice.

elements.name: Hope‑tired
elements.definition: You’ve hoped for a long time and feel worn out.

elements.name: Surprised
elements.definition: Something unexpected happened; can be good or hard.
elements.negative: Take a breath before reacting.
elements.positive: Stay curious.

elements.name: Shocked
elements.definition: Something intense and sudden impacted you deeply.
elements.negative: Sit, breathe, drink water, and get support.
elements.positive: Give yourself time to adjust.

elements.name: Joyful
elements.definition: You feel deep happiness and aliveness.

elements.name: Bittersweet
elements.definition: You feel happy and sad at the same time.
elements.negative: Write it out, then ask what you need to feel better.
elements.positive: Letting it soften frees your energy for what is good.

elements.name: Protectively Angry
elements.definition: You feel anger because you care and want safety.

elements.name: Misunderstood
elements.definition: You feel people don’t get your experience or intent.

elements.name: Seen
elements.definition: You feel truly noticed and understood.

elements.name: Overlooked
elements.definition: You feel passed over or skipped; your presence matters.

elements.name: Encouraged
elements.definition: You feel lifted up by words or actions from others.

elements.name: Discouraged
elements.definition: You feel weighed down or doubting your ability.

elements.name: Resentful
elements.definition: You hold onto anger about something that felt unfair.
elements.negative: Say what you need and set a boundary.
elements.positive: Releasing it gives you energy.

elements.name: Reluctant
elements.definition: You feel pulled toward something but hesitant to act.

elements.name: Eager
elements.definition: You feel ready and wanting to move forward.
elements.negative: Slow down so you do not skip steps.
elements.positive: Channel it into prepared action.

elements.name: Overconfident
elements.definition: You may underestimate risk; invites balance.

elements.name: Underconfident
elements.definition: You underestimate your ability; invites truth and support.

elements.name: Homesick
elements.definition: You miss a place, time, or feeling of home.

elements.name: Belonging
elements.definition: You feel like you fit and are accepted.

elements.name: Out of Place
elements.definition: You feel like you don’t fit the environment or group.

elements.name: Focused
elements.definition: Your attention is steady on one thing.

elements.name: Distracted
elements.definition: Your attention keeps jumping; needs refocus or rest.

elements.name: Impatient
elements.definition: You want something to happen faster; invites pacing.

elements.name: Patient
elements.definition: You’re willing to wait and trust the process.
elements.negative: If it is wearing thin, take a break.
elements.positive: It lets good things grow.

elements.name: Competitive
elements.definition: You want to win or be the best; can motivate or stress.
elements.negative: If it drains you, set limits and refill your own cup.
elements.positive: Offer presence; it is often enough.

elements.name: Cooperative
elements.definition: You want to work together and share success.

elements.name: Protectively Quiet
elements.definition: You stay silent to feel safe; your voice still matters.

elements.name: Expressive
elements.definition: You share your thoughts and feelings openly.

elements.name: Overexposed
elements.definition: You feel like you shared too much; needs safety and boundaries.

elements.name: Grounded
elements.definition: You feel steady, present, and connected to reality.

elements.name: Spaced Out
elements.definition: You feel far away in your mind; often from stress or overload.

elements.name: Curious About Self
elements.definition: You want to understand who you are becoming.

elements.name: Curious About Others
elements.definition: You want to understand people around you.

elements.name: Protectively Closed
elements.definition: You keep your heart guarded; often from past hurt.

elements.name: Open‑hearted
elements.definition: You feel willing to connect deeply, even with risk.

elements.name: Future‑focused
elements.definition: Your mind is on what’s ahead; can inspire or worry.

elements.name: Past‑stuck
elements.definition: Your mind keeps replaying what already happened.

elements.name: Present‑aware
elements.definition: You notice what’s happening right now.

elements.name: Identity‑curious
elements.definition: You’re wondering who you are and who you’ll be.

elements.name: Identity‑tired
elements.definition: You feel worn out from trying to figure yourself out.

elements.name: Identity‑proud
elements.definition: You feel good about who you’re becoming.

elements.name: Identity‑uncertain
elements.definition: You’re not sure yet; that’s okay—this is the path.

elements.name: Grief
elements.definition: The ache of a loss.
elements.negative: Cry, talk, and remember; do not rush it, and get support.
elements.positive: Honor what you loved and let others carry you.

elements.name: Love
elements.definition: Deep care and connection.
elements.negative: If love hurts, protect your safety and boundaries.
elements.positive: Express it often and plainly.

elements.name: Joy
elements.definition: Deep, bright gladness.
elements.negative: If you fear it will go, savor it now.
elements.positive: Spread it.

elements.name: Fear
elements.definition: Alarm at a possible danger.
elements.negative: Check if the danger is real; breathe and ask for help.
elements.positive: Fear can protect you; use it as a guide.

elements.name: Happiness
elements.definition: A general feeling of well-being.
elements.negative: If it feels unearned, accept it anyway.
elements.positive: Share it and build habits that keep it.

elements.name: Kindness
elements.definition: Gentle, generous care.
elements.negative: Include yourself; kindness is not self-neglect.
elements.positive: One small kind act can change a day.

elements.name: Forgiveness
elements.definition: Releasing the hold a hurt has on you.
elements.negative: You can forgive without staying close to someone harmful.
elements.positive: It frees you; go at your own pace.

elements.name: Resilience
elements.definition: Bouncing back from hardship.
elements.negative: Rest and ask for help; resilience is not doing it alone.
elements.positive: Remember what got you through.

elements.name: Worthiness
elements.definition: Knowing you deserve care and belonging.
elements.negative: On low days, repeat it and ask someone who loves you.
elements.positive: Live it by treating yourself and others well.

elements.name: Courage
elements.definition: Acting well even while afraid.
elements.negative: If you feel you have none, take the smallest brave step.
elements.positive: Share your story; it gives others courage.

elements.name: Empathy
elements.definition: Understanding how someone else feels.
elements.negative: If you absorb too much, take space.
elements.positive: Listen without fixing; it helps.

elements.name: Respect
elements.definition: Valuing someone's worth and boundaries.
elements.negative: If it is not returned, protect yourself.
elements.positive: Give it freely and model it.

elements.name: Loyalty
elements.definition: Staying faithful to people or values.
elements.negative: If it keeps you in harm, rethink it.
elements.positive: Be dependable and honest.

elements.name: Serenity
elements.definition: Deep, quiet peace.
elements.negative: Do not avoid problems; return to them calm.
elements.positive: Practice stillness daily.

elements.name: Shame
elements.definition: Feeling that you are bad, not just that you did something bad.
elements.negative: Share with someone safe; shame shrinks in kind company.
elements.positive: You are more than your mistakes.

elements.name: Panic
elements.definition: Sudden, intense fear.
elements.negative: Breathe slowly, feel your feet on the floor, and tell yourself it will pass.
elements.positive: Practice calm skills when okay.

elements.name: Awe
elements.definition: Feeling small in front of something vast or beautiful.
elements.negative: If it feels overwhelming, ground yourself with slow breaths.
elements.positive: Seek it out: sky, music, stories, people at their best.
